labels.desc: All 403 it.each rows send a valid body, so moving assertPermission below body parsing (getRequestBody) stays green; a non-admin with a malformed body would get a 400 leaking schema detail
Online Checkout (external service) may now receive 403 from the new createAgreement permission gate
In-repo callers reach the new permission check as the system service key, not the end user, because SystemConnector.post overwrites Authorization
Follow-up comment should cite BAU-2523; queryBinary unreachable because its route is commented out
In completeRegistration the Okta/SSO-link check runs only after passkeyService.completeRegistration has already persisted the credential (write before refuse)
assertLocalSignInAllowed guard is called only after a successful-login write has already happened on guarded paths
Duplicates the SSO-link guard logic that the PR centralises in AuthService.assertLocalSignInAllowed
No test that completeRegistration refuses an Okta-linked user; the guard mock defaults to resolved, so deleting the guard keeps tests green
hasLinkForUser rule (userId filter, limit 1, result !== undefined) is always mocked and never tested directly
forgotPasswordSkipReason helper placed between the PasswordService class JSDoc and the decorator
Service-token gate only checks type !== 'api' instead of using the repo's isTrustedServiceToken helper
Session minted with tfa: true only because a comment says Okta enforces MFA; nothing verifies the MFA claim (amr) on the token
Missing OKTA_ISSUER / OKTA_CLIENT_ID / SSO_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS env vars are not caught at startup and fail at sign-in time

jwtVerify with createRemoteJWKSet fetches Okta's signing keys over the network, so JWKS timeouts and fetch failures land in the same catch as real signature or claim failures (infrastructure errors reported as invalid tokens)
The OIDC discovery fetch has no timeout
Okta discovery failure (non-2xx, missing jwks_uri, network TypeError) surfaces as a raw error instead of a mapped auth/service error
markUsed / lastUsedAt bookkeeping is awaited on the sign-in critical path, so its failure blocks the sign-in
Discovery response body is read untyped (no schema/shape check) before use
resolveUser calls createEmployee and link as separate non-transactional writes, so a failure between them leaves an unlinked user
Link test uses role admin with accountType admin and reject tests use non-staff roles, so fixtures cannot distinguish the link path from the reject path
Nonce handling note (low confidence, below gate in both past runs)
Giggle secret, SSN and DOB sent over the Connector with TLS verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false)
rawRequest: toJsonColumn(request) persists the whole Giggle request, including SSN/DOB PII, to prospect.sbl_lead_offer
Raw exception text is stored in errorMessage and returned to guest/customer reads
A callback that loses the compare-and-set to a non-callback writer is answered 200 and ignored, so the lender's decision is lost
CLOSED_STATUSES omits EXPIRED, so a late callback can reopen an expired offer
markAccepted is the only status write without compare-and-set
If the outcome write fails after the lender accepted, the sweep calls the lender again (duplicate submission)
Migration down() fails with unique violation 23505 once rows are EXPIRED
An offer expired on the request path never reaches Salesforce as EXPIRED
EXTERNAL_API_ROLES deny-list: apps built with the old component-permission treat a lender API token as allowed (rollout-order gate)
authenticateFundbox posts with no timeout and default retries
Pre-check reads catch every failure (timeout, 5xx, network, Env.get throwing) and treat it as a pass/skip
LeadsModule.initalize() awaits the full sweep before prospect-api starts listening
updateLenderOfferStatus / updateMatchedLenderOpportunityOfferStatus catch and log every error, so status-sync failures are silently dropped
A slow vendor-api stalls the lost-submit re-send and later ticks skip
No index covers lead_account_id for the CTA click lookup
Giggle is still listed in LEADS_NON_API_LENDERS
offers-* permission grants are never tested with real roles (hides a real bug: customer offers-read is false)
PENDING can be removed from OPEN_OFFER_STATUSES with all tests passing
Compare-and-set expectedStatus is tested only with REQUESTED rows
lenderRef test cannot distinguish incoming ?? stored from stored ?? incoming
Comment says EXPIRED is never written but it is stored
Comment says no PII lives in this table but raw_request holds SSN/DOB
Comment says SSN is never stored by this module but it ends up in raw_request
rawRequest/rawResponse descriptions swapped
Docblock contradicts OFFER_AWAITING_ANSWER_STATUSES
Class docblock lists 2 steps, execute() runs 4
Comment names the wrong parseCallback caller
Route doc claims each offer carries sblid; schema has none
Comment describes wait-window behaviour the code does not have
'Node keeps the promise alive' comment is wrong
Docstring about reaching the mapper through element access is inaccurate
Private copy of the isUUID regex
Expire-then-live-check sequence written twice
buildSweepConfig repeats the system-job request config from another job
timeOutSilentLenders re-implements the per-row Salesforce mirror loop
Open-offer rule duplicated
Giggle credentials entry untyped in LenderCredentials
Casts as GiggleBusinessEntity / GigglePrimaryOwner exist only because of a missing type
.slice(0,2) drops values the test should pin
Only the first lender expire call is pinned
'abc' is the only invalid offerId fixture
Lender input hard-coded by lender name
normalizeBodies uses the `in` operator on the raw request body; a null or scalar body throws TypeError instead of the AJV INVALID_INPUT error
RequestLogService create/update/upsert do not apply normalizeBodies (preexisting, file untouched)
A 204 empty body is stored as {origResponseBody: ''} where the ticket expects {}
e2e docblock says the '' row fails the jsonb INSERT but response_body is TEXT there
Claim that a top-level array body would be encrypted before AJV runs when logger encryption is on (logger encryption does not apply there)
After an errored pre-#2053 refresh, the migration copies the failed generation's token into the READY asset-report row
Migration hardcodes days_requested = 730 for rows that still hold the import's original token, which #2053 labels 153
days_requested on the inserted asset-report row is never asserted
The 'leaves untouched' safety table covers only one shape (no encrypted/hashed Plaid Link case)
Matching rows by ciphertext equality breaks after data-key rotation
Sibling spec docblock claims to be the only writing spec
Mapping Salesforce failures to 503 makes the Connector's default retries replay the Salesforce calls up to 3 times per user while the advisory lock is held
Token-fetch catches now surface a bare 'invalid_grant' message instead of 'authentication failure - <url>' (SFMC token and events catches too)
Only 3 of the 10 new maxRetries: 0 Salesforce creates are asserted in the spec
linkExternalFile's new maxRetries: 0 has no test
maxRetries: 0 on the Preference_Profile__c create is not asserted (spec matcher checks only headers)
SFMC token catch status-to-error-type mapping is pinned by a single vendor-500 row
preinstall 'npx only-allow pnpm' is unpinned: it downloads and runs whatever only-allow version is latest on npm on every install, in CI and Docker
Any non-ok getAssetReport status, including a transient 5xx/429, permanently adds the suite's own connection to ruledOut
If the refresh poll on A throws, Promise.all rejects at once while resolve(importB) keeps polling unwatched, so B's connection leaks
If resolve(imports.a) throws, connections from imports c and m are never cleaned up
One non-2xx from logger.vendorLogs anywhere in the 8-minute poll throws and aborts the whole poll
`as` cast makes every envelope level optional and `?? []` turns a missing or malformed report into an empty list
New private ImportRow type duplicates the Generation type that plaid-50 and plaid-38 declare
mintDlpTokens runs eagerly in beforeAll, so one mint failure fails every test including the 11 sad-path cases that never use a token
`as Channel[]` cast skips the literal check, so a misspelled channel compiles
mintDlpTokens result typed Record<string, DlpToken> instead of Record<Channel, DlpToken>
pick() throws 'No ... in NF Salesforce' even when the query returned candidates that all failed the filter
Six independent Tokenizer mints and picks are awaited one by one instead of concurrently
Minted DLP tokens are printed to CI logs as plain values
pg_execute_query accepts an optional connectionString that replaces the hardened one while PG* env still supplies the password, so the password can go to another host or read-only can be dropped
CLAUDE.md now says three MCP servers but README.md (outside the diff) still says two and omits postgres
Token fetch has no catch: a network failure rejects the top-level await, crashing with no org alias named and skipping the remaining orgs
npx -y @salesforce/cli is unpinned (bypasses pnpm minimumReleaseAge) and the child inherits the full environment
Claim that the refactor to shared soql drops the NATIONAL_FUNDING x-brand argument (vendor-api never reads that header)
useEffect schedules setTimeout(() => setErrors([])) without returning a cleanup that clears it: an earlier error batch's timer wipes a newer batch early and setErrors fires after unmount

jest.spyOn(repositoryModule, 'normalizeIssuer') on a bare named export violates .claude/rules/testing-gotchas.md: under @swc/jest it throws 'Cannot redefine property'; export an object and call through it
